# Asset sources and licenses

All Poly Haven assets below are CC0, downloaded from the official Poly Haven API and CDN.

- Rock Face 01, Dario Barresi: https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_face_01 — glTF model and 1K diffuse, normal and ARM maps.
- Tree Small 02: https://polyhaven.com/a/tree_small_02 — glTF tree with branch, leaf and trunk textures. Geometry simplified locally with meshoptimizer for browser use; desktop approximately 155K triangles, mobile approximately 27K triangles per tree.
- Mossy Rock: https://polyhaven.com/a/mossy_rock — diffuse, OpenGL normal, roughness.
- Forest Ground 04: https://polyhaven.com/a/forest_ground_04 — diffuse, OpenGL normal, roughness.
- Wood Planks: https://polyhaven.com/a/wood_planks — diffuse, OpenGL normal, roughness.
- Grey Roof Tiles: https://polyhaven.com/a/grey_roof_tiles — diffuse, OpenGL normal, roughness.

Three.js 0.180.0, GLTFLoader, BufferGeometryUtils, Water, Reflector and example waternormals.jpg: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180 — MIT; see THREE-LICENSE.txt. Addon imports are adapted to local modules. Water shader adjustments are applied by the application.

Original painting and early unused layer artwork were generated with built-in imagegen, as described in the root README and original prompt record. No Nintendo assets are included; Breath of the Wild is an art-direction reference only.
